categories.name: Whole Chicken
categories.description: Sourced directly from farms, thoroughly cleaned whole dressed chicken — ideal for whole roast, tandoori, and custom home carving.

categories.name: Curry Cut Chicken
categories.description: Uniform bone-in pieces ideal for traditional homestyle curries, rich gravies, and flavorful biryani.

categories.name: Boneless Chicken
categories.description: Tender, lean boneless chicken cuts — perfect for chicken tikka, stir-fry, and biryani.

categories.name: Chicken Breast
categories.description: Skinless, lean high-protein chicken breast fillets — ideal for healthy diets, grilling, and salads.

categories.name: Chicken Leg Pieces
categories.description: Juicy drumsticks and whole leg quarters — ideal for tandoori roasting, BBQ grill, and crispy frying.

categories.name: Chicken Wings
categories.description: Plump, fresh chicken wings perfect for smoky BBQ glaze, spicy hot wings, and crispy appetizers.

categories.name: Farm Fresh Eggs
categories.description: Wholesome country brown eggs and classic white farm eggs sourced fresh every morning.

products.name: Farm Fresh Curry Cut Chicken (Skinless)
products.description: 12 to 16 uniform bone-in pieces. Excess fat and skin trimmed away, hygienically prepped and ready to cook.

products.name: Premium Boneless Chicken Breast
products.description: Lean, high-protein skinless chicken breast fillet. Perfect for healthy fitness diets, grilling, and fresh salads.

products.name: Whole Cleaned Chicken (Skin-on)
products.description: Fully cleaned, juicy whole dressed chicken with skin on — ideal for whole roasts, tandoori, and custom home carving.

products.name: Juicy Chicken Drumsticks
products.description: Juicy, cleanly trimmed drumsticks and leg portions. Ideal for tandoori, oven roasting, or crispy frying.

products.name: Boneless Chicken Tikka Cubes
products.description: Uniform bite-sized boneless chicken cubes. Ready to marinate for tikka, kebabs, fried rice, and biryani.

products.name: Fresh Whole Chicken Wings
products.description: Meaty, fresh chicken wings perfect for BBQ glaze, hot wings, and crispy air-fryer appetizers.

products.name: Free-Range Brown Country Eggs
products.description: Healthy, nutrient-rich free-range brown farm eggs sourced from trusted country poultry farms.

products.name: Classic White Farm Eggs (Tray)
products.description: Daily fresh farm arrival. Clean shells, consistent high grade, and wholesome everyday eggs.

products.name: Skinless Whole Dressed Chicken
products.description: Hygienically dressed skinless whole chicken prepared fresh to order — ready for custom home carving.

products.name: Authentic Country Chicken Curry Cut
products.description: Authentic country chicken (Nattu Kozhi) with robust texture and traditional rich flavor — ideal for slow-cooked curries.

products.name: Marinated Tandoori Leg Quarters
products.description: Whole chicken leg and thigh quarters pre-marinated in house spices, ready for oven roasting or tandoori grilling.

products.name: Fresh Cleaned Chicken Liver
products.description: Iron-rich, cleanly washed and chilled chicken liver packed safely in hygienic leak-proof trays.

products.name: Boneless Chicken Thigh Fillets
products.description: Juicy skinless, boneless chicken thigh fillets — tender, flavorful, and succulent when seared or braised.

products.name: Seasoned Party Wings
products.description: Weekend special marinated wings tossed in aromatic herbs and cracked pepper blend.

banners.title: Freshly & Hygienically Cut Farm Chicken Every Morning
banners.subtitle: Tender curry cuts, lean boneless breast, whole chicken, and farm-fresh eggs — prepped clean to your exact preference.

enquiries.message: சனிக்கிழமை குடும்ப விருந்திற்கு 5 கிலோ தோல் நீக்கிய கறிக்கட் மற்றும் 2 கிலோ எலும்பில்லா டிக்கா க்யூப்ஸ் தேவைப்படுகிறது. காலை 10 மணிக்குள் டெலிவரி செய்ய முடியுமா?
enquiries.message_en: Need 5 kg skinless curry cut and 2 kg boneless tikka cubes for a Saturday family feast. Can you deliver by 10 AM?

enquiries.message: எங்கள் ஃபிட்னஸ் உணவகத்திற்கு வாரந்தோறும் சிக்கன் பிரஸ்ட் மற்றும் நாட்டுக்கோழி முட்டைகள் மொத்தமாக சப்ளை செய்ய இயலுமா?
enquiries.message_en: Can you supply weekly bulk orders of fresh chicken breast and country eggs for our fitness eatery?

enquiries.message: நாளை காலையில் பாரம்பரிய நாட்டுக்கோழி கறிக்கட் இருப்பு இருக்குமா என்று அறிய விரும்புகிறேன்.
enquiries.message_en: Would like to inquire if traditional country chicken (Nattu Kozhi) curry cuts will be available tomorrow morning.
